why_agent_cannot: accept the project's terms in your own name
what_human_must_do: Read and accept the project terms in your own name.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Open Revert and connect a wallet Go to the Revert homepage and use the Connect Account button with the wallet that holds your USDC.
2 Step 2 : Open the lending section Use the Start lending button on the homepage, or the Lending item in the main navigation, to reach the lending pools.
4 Step 4 : Find the Points tab The main navigation of the Revert site has a Points tab for the program.
